    }
    option = {
        name = ywc_jhg.1021.switch_ambiguity
        trigger = { var:ywc_jhg_tribute_route ?= 2 ywc_jhg_tribute_can_advance = yes has_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_filing_fee_paid government_legitimacy >= 30 }
        ai_chance = { base = 15 }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_jhg.1021.switch_ambiguity.cost_tooltip }
        custom_tooltip = { text = ywc_jhg.1021.switch_ambiguity.consequence_tooltip }
        if = { limit = { var:ywc_jhg_tribute_route ?= 2 ywc_jhg_tribute_can_advance = yes has_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_filing_fee_paid government_legitimacy >= 30 } ywc_jhg_tribute_choose_ambiguity = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_jhg_tribute_pending_event value = 1022 } } else = { set_variable = { name = ywc_jhg_tribute_pending_event value = 1021 } }
    }
    option = {

    }

        name = ywc_jhg.1021.continue_domestic
        trigger = { ywc_jhg_tribute_can_advance = yes has_variable = ywc_jhg_tribute_filing_fee_paid OR = { AND = { var:ywc_jhg_tribute_route ?= 1 bureaucracy >= 20 } AND = { var:ywc_jhg_tribute_route ?= 3 government_legitimacy >= 30 } } }
